You’re very close, and this is a classic production SPA + auth redirect issue, not a backend or Clerk bug.
I’ll explain line-by-line WHY this happens and then give you exact fixes.

🔴 Root Cause (Single Core Problem)

Your app is a Single Page Application (React) deployed on Vercel, but:

❌ Vercel does not know how to handle deep routes like
/dashboard, /login/factor-one, /session/join/:id

So when Clerk (or Google OAuth) redirects the browser to those URLs directly, Vercel tries to find a real file/page at that path → 404 Not Found.

Then when you manually go back to /, React loads, auth state exists, and client-side routing works, so dashboard appears.

👉 Nothing is wrong with auth itself.
👉 Nothing is wrong with your backend.
👉 This is a routing + deployment config issue.

🧠 Why Each Issue Is Happening (Explained One by One)
1️⃣ /login/factor-one → 404 after login
What’s happening:

Clerk redirects to /login/factor-one for MFA / verification

Vercel tries to load /login/factor-one as a static page

That file does not exist → 404

Why it works after going back:

You go to /

React app loads

Clerk sees user is logged in

React Router redirects to /dashboard

✅ Auth succeeded
❌ Router never got a chance to run on /login/factor-one

2️⃣ Google login → /dashboard?__clerk_handshake=... → 404
What’s happening:

OAuth callback redirects to /dashboard?...

Vercel again tries to load /dashboard as a real page

No rewrite → 404

Why pasting / works:

Same reason: React loads first, then routing works

3️⃣ Session invite link /session/join/7NOAVIQI → 404
What’s happening:

This is a deep link

Vercel has no idea this route belongs to React Router

No rewrite rule → 404

4️⃣ Why admin panel, profile, sessions work

Because you are navigating to them from inside the app, not refreshing or opening directly.

Client-side navigation = ✅
Direct URL / refresh = ❌

✅ THE REAL FIX (This Solves ALL Issues)
🔧 Add a vercel.json rewrite rule

This tells Vercel:

“For any route, serve index.html and let React Router decide.”

📁 Create vercel.json in the root of frontend
{
  "rewrites": [
    {
      "source": "/(.*)",
      "destination": "/"
    }
  ]
}


📌 IMPORTANT

This file must be in the frontend root

Same level as package.json

🚀 Redeploy to Vercel
git add vercel.json
git commit -m "Fix SPA routing for Clerk and deep links"
git push


Then redeploy on Vercel.

🟢 After This, ALL These Will Work:

✅ /login/factor-one
✅ /dashboard
✅ /dashboard?__clerk_handshake=...
✅ /session/join/:id
✅ Page refresh on any route
✅ Direct link sharing

🧩 Optional Clerk Best Practice (Recommended)

In Clerk dashboard or config:

<ClerkProvider
  afterSignInUrl="/dashboard"
  afterSignUpUrl="/dashboard"
  signInUrl="/login"
  signUpUrl="/signup"
/>


This avoids unexpected redirects.

🧠 Mental Model (Remember This Forever)
Environment	Routing
Local dev	Works automatically
SPA (React)	Needs rewrite
Vercel	❌ No rewrite by default
Clerk OAuth	Uses deep URLs
Result	404 unless rewrites exist
✅ Final Verdict

❌ Not a Clerk bug

❌ Not backend issue

❌ Not env variable issue

✅ Missing SPA rewrite configuration

This is one of the most common production mistakes, even senior devs hit it.
